description: Release-group ("the album" above specific pressings) by MBID: primary type (Album/Single/EP) and secondary types (Live/Compilation), first-release date, artist credit, the list of releases (editions), tags/genres, and cover-art availability from the Cover Art Archive (image count and front/back flags for the release-group's representative release — the art musicbrainz_get_cover_art returns; use that tool for the image URLs). The embedded releases list is capped at one page (25); for the complete set of editions, call musicbrainz_browse_entities with target_type=release and link.release-group. For a specific edition's tracklist, take a release MBID from the releases list and call musicbrainz_get_release.
name: musicbrainz_get_release_group

items.description: One credited artist within an artist credit.

artistId.description: MBID of the credited artist — chain to musicbrainz_get_artist.

joinPhrase.description: Text that joins this credit to the next (e.g. " feat. ", " & "). Omitted when empty.

name.description: Credited name as it appears on the release (may be an alias).

artistCreditString.description: Display string of the artist credit with join phrases.

cap.description: The one-page cap that was applied. Absent when not truncated.

coverArt.description: Cover-art availability from the Cover Art Archive: the images of the release-group's representative release, the same art musicbrainz_get_cover_art returns (exists: false with count 0 when the archive has none). Omitted when the archive lookup could not complete — the notice says so.

back.description: Whether a designated back image exists. Omitted when unknown.

count.description: Number of images available. Omitted when unknown.

exists.description: Whether the Cover Art Archive has any artwork for this entity.

front.description: Whether a designated front image exists. Omitted when unknown.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 400). `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no release-group exists with it (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

firstReleaseDate.description: Earliest release date across all editions. Omitted when absent.

notice.description: Present when the releases list was capped (how to fetch the complete set of editions) and/or when cover-art availability could not be checked (why coverArt is omitted).

primaryType.description: Primary type (Album, Single, EP, Broadcast, Other). Omitted when absent.

releases.description: Releases (editions) in this group (one page; may be empty or capped — use browse for all).

country.description: Release country code. Omitted when absent.

mbid.description: Release MBID — chain to musicbrainz_get_release for the tracklist.

status.description: Release status (Official, Promotion, …). Omitted when absent.

secondaryTypes.description: Secondary types (Live, Compilation, Soundtrack, …). Omitted when none.

shown.description: Number of releases returned. Absent when not truncated.

items.description: A folksonomy tag or genre with its vote count.

count.description: Community vote count for this tag.

truncated.description: True when the releases list hit the one-page cap and more editions exist. Absent when the full set fit in one page.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: get release group
